description_excerpt: Passionate about Digital Verification and AI? Join Infineon Hanoi to shape the future of semiconductor verification by developing innovative AI-driven methodologies, solving complex RTL verification challenges, and collaborating with global engineering teams. Your role Key responsibilities in your new role • Develop reusable verification methodologies, with a focus on the use of AI, to accelerate verification workflows across Infineon. • Support deployment of developed methodologies to verification teams across Infineon. • Provide proactive support to internal users of the verification flow…
